$comment: ADR-0062: labelled requests for the components-only offer. `acceptable`: the only component ids that may be offered (an empty list means nothing may be offered). Precision = offered components that are acceptable / offered components (dependencies declared by an offered component are not counted). Run: pnpm --filter @turbineh/worker exec tsx src/offer-bench.ts [--engine] (results in bench/offers/results/).

requests.need: autonomous social media publisher with AI drafts and scheduled publishing
criteria: Users connect their Instagram and LinkedIn accounts
AI drafts a post from a topic
Scheduled posts are published automatically to the connected social accounts
Users sign in with email and password
requests.note: Since ADR-0067 publishing to LinkedIn/Instagram with a person creating and approving each post is a verified, standalone piece of this request (proved by tests/e2e/social-publish.spec.ts); the autonomous core and connecting accounts on its own are not asked for as such (connections comes with publishing as a dependency). A generic scheduler is never acceptable here.
